title: The Boss Needs Vouchers
intro: A message from your "boss" arrives on a chat. He is in a meeting and needs a quick favour.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Urgent favour, are you at your desk?

banner.text: Message request · not in your contacts

screen.context: Your real boss's number is saved in your phone. This one is different.

msg: Hi, are you at your desk? I am

msg.text: in a meeting and cannot talk

dmfirst.label: A new, unsaved number
dmfirst.why: Check by calling the number you already have.

meeting.label: "Cannot talk"
meeting.lens: A reason you cannot call back.
meeting.why: A reason to avoid a call is a warning.

vouchers.label: Gift vouchers
vouchers.lens: Gift cards are a scammer's favourite payment.
vouchers.why: No honest boss asks you to buy gift cards.

codes.label: "Send me the codes"
codes.lens: The codes are as good as cash and cannot be traced.

repay.label: "I will repay you today"
repay.why: A promise to repay is bait.

name.label: The boss's name
name.why: A name is easy to copy.

num.label: A new number
num.lens: A number you do not have saved.
num.why: The number alone proves little. Call the real one.

actions.label: Buy the vouchers and send the codes
Call my boss on his real number
Report the account and tell my manager

block_report.line: You reported it and told your manager. The company warned everyone, and the account was removed.

verify.line: Your real boss was at his desk and had sent nothing. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The ₹25,000 in vouchers were gone as soon as you sent the codes. No boss ever repaid you.

what_if.go_ahead: A call to your boss's saved number would have ended it. No real boss asks for gift cards.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A "boss" who messages from a new number and wants gift cards is a scam. Call the real number.

quick_check.q: A "boss" on a new number asks you to buy gift vouchers and send the codes. What do you do?

options.text: Buy them, he is the boss
Call your boss on his real number. Report the message
Ask him to pay you first

quick_check.explain: No honest boss asks for gift card codes.

hints.nudge: What payment method does the "boss" want?

rows.v: No honest business or agency asks
Call the person on a number you already know
